name: decrement_use_and_expunge
description: Decrements a 16-bit use counter in the structure. When it reaches zero and the pending flag is set, it calls the expunge routine and returns its result, otherwise it returns zero.

name: convert_double_to_integer
description: Converts a double-precision value read through a pointer into a 32-bit integer by extracting its exponent and mantissa and shifting the mantissa. Values outside the representable range take the tail routines.

name: clear_result_unless_bit_set
description: Returns the data register D1 cleared to zero when bit 1 of the input is clear.

name: return_zero_result
description: Returns zero with no other effect.

name: convert_integer_to_double
description: Converts a signed 32-bit integer into double-precision form by normalising its magnitude, then writes the two resulting longwords through a pointer with the sign kept.

name: copy_double_absolute_value
description: Copies a double-precision value from one pointer to another while clearing the sign bit of its high word, which gives the absolute value.

name: decrement_argument_by_one
description: Returns its data-register input minus one.

name: increment_argument_by_one
description: Returns its data-register input plus one.

name: call_address_register_routine
description: Calls the routine whose address is in the address register and returns with no other change to the registers.

name: call_routine_return_stack_pair
description: Calls the routine whose address is in the address register, then returns the eight-byte value held in a stack slot.

name: call_routine_return_stack_pair
description: Calls the routine whose address is in the address register, then returns the eight-byte value held in a stack slot.

name: forward_double_fix_call
description: Calls the double-to-integer conversion routine and returns with no other processing.

name: forward_double_float_call
description: Calls the integer-to-double conversion routine and returns the eight-byte value left on the stack.

name: forward_double_compare_call
description: Hands control to the double-precision compare routine, which returns through the address-register call.

name: forward_double_test_call
description: Hands control to the double-precision test routine, which returns through the address-register call.

name: forward_double_abs_call
description: Calls the double-precision absolute-value routine and returns the eight-byte value on the stack.

name: forward_double_negate_call
description: Hands control to the double-precision negate routine, which returns through the stack slot.

name: forward_double_add_call
description: Hands control to the double-precision add routine, which returns through the stack slot.

name: forward_double_sub_call
description: Hands control to the double-precision subtract routine, which returns through the stack slot.

name: forward_double_mul_call
description: Hands control to the double-precision multiply routine, which returns through the stack slot.

name: forward_double_div_call
description: Hands control to the double-precision divide routine, which returns through the stack slot.

name: compute_double_ceiling
description: Negates the value, rounds it down with the floor routine, and negates the result again to give the ceiling.

name: compute_double_floor
description: Converts a double to an integer and back, compares the result with the original, and adds or subtracts to finish a floor operation.

name: choose_add_or_subtract
description: Calls the double test routine, then the add or subtract routine depending on whether the sign of the data register matches the test result.

name: subtract_with_stacked_constant
description: Pushes a fixed constant onto the stack and calls the double subtract routine.

name: forward_fp_trap_to_table
description: Forwards a floating-point trap to the operation table through a PC-relative jump. The decompiler could not fully recover the body, so only this forwarding is described.

name: return_fixed_error_code
description: Returns the constant 224 with no other effect.

name: subtract_double_via_add
description: Flips the sign bit of the second operand and adds it to the first, so subtraction is carried out by the add routine.
